name: Karolina Dean

abilityDetails.Instinct: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Instant Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Intensify: Yeni oluşturulan tüm buff'ların gücünü bir yüzde artırır.
abilityDetails.Pulverize: Bir Armor Up etkisini kaldırır ve doğrudan hasar verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Işık alanındayken engellenemez saldırı ve pasif güç kazanımı kazanır — engellenemez özel saldırıları bloklayan şampiyon avantajlı. Nötralize, nötrleştirme, bonus immünitesi ve fate-seal'a immün değil, bu yeteneklere sahip herhangi bir şampiyon iyi çalışır.
signatureAbility:
Shine In The Sky Like Diamonds
Whenever Karolina has her Block struck by a Heavy Attack, she consumes 6 Iridescence Buffs to resist a Block Break and grant herself a Glancing Buff for the duration of the attack.
At 6+ Iridescence Buffs, personal Incinerates also Pulverize 1 Armor Up effect, removing it and dealing a burst of [3,534.44 - 7,394.32] Direct Damage.
For each Iridescence Buff, gain [1 - 5]% increased Incinerate potency, up to 6 Iridescence Buffs.
immunityDetails:
• %100 Yakma direnci 🔥
• Ani Soğuk Bağışıklığı 🧊
• Güç Kilidi Bağışıklığı 🔋⛔

abilitySections.title: Glowing with Majesdanian Sunshine - Always Active
content: Karolina's Majesdanian physiology grants her 100% Resistance to Incinerate effects. Additionally, Incinerate effects do not lower her Block Proficiency or remove her Perfect Block chance.
Karolina's solar energy-infused body also causes her attacks to deal Energy Damage and grants her Immunity to Special Lock, Power Lock, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects.
Karolina has a youthful pep in her step granting her an indefinite Instinct Buff.

abilitySections.title: Soak in the Iridescent Sun
content: Karolina can absorb indefinite Iridescence Buffs from the sun as it shines down in various locations across the stage. After appearing briefly, the sun fades away before appearing again in a new location. Karolina starts with 2 Iridescence Buffs. Max stacks: 15.
While in the sun, Karolina gains the following abilities:
Karolina gains 1 Iridescence Buff every 0.65 seconds.
Karolina gains a Power Gain Buff, granting 2% of a Bar of Power each second for each Iridescence Buff, up to 6.
Charging a Heavy Attack in the sun after landing a non-Combo-Ending Attack inflicts a Stun Passive for 2.2 seconds. This Stun cannot have its duration modified by Tech Champions.
If Karolina activates a Special Attack while in the sun, she gains an Unblockable Buff for the duration of the Special.
As an Attacker, Karolina stands still while in the sun.

abilitySections.title: Solar Shield Block
content: Whenever Karolina Blocks a hit, she consumes Iridescence Buffs based on the Blocked attack to grant herself a Glancing Buff for the duration of the attack. This Buff is removed if Karolina is struck.
When the Opponent Glances against Karolina, damage is reduced by 85% and Offensive Ability Accuracy is reduced by 40%.
Light and Medium Attacks - 1 Buff.
Special Attack 1 - 3 Buffs.
Special Attack 2 - 6 Buffs.
Whenever Iridescence Buffs are consumed by Blocking, inflict a [222.97] Energy Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds for each Buff consumed. Max stacks: 6.

abilitySections.title: Solar-Infused Incinerates
content: Personal Incinerate Passives deal [6,193.39] Energy Damage over 14 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 12. As a Defender, personal Incinerates scale with Base Attack only and deal half damage.

During Karolina's Special Attacks, personal Incinerates deal no damage. Instead, each of Karolina's Special Attack hits inflicts an Instant Incinerate for each personal Incinerate active, dealing a burst of [1,382.99] Energy Damage per bar of Power spent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Gain 8 Iridescence Buffs over the course of the Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit consumes 1 Iridescence Buff to inflict 1 personal Incinerate Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Consume up to 12 Iridescence Buffs to inflict 12 personal Incinerate Passives.
Gain a non-stacking 10% Intensify Buff for 24 seconds. While active, Karolina generates Iridescence Buffs 35% faster while in the sun.
